text: There is a sense of curiosity as I observe the room of people engaged in discussion from outside the glass wall. I feel a bit like an outsider gazing in, contemplating what binds them together and what ideas might flow within. Moving to the next vivid, colorful wall, my attention is grabbed by the bold letters "R+D" and the phrase about innovation. Here, I feel inspired and reflective, surrounded by the evidence of thoughtful creation and human attempts to make meaning and progress. It feels vibrant and hopeful.
